-- stale-adr.md --

# ============================================================
# Section 1: akb lint with CEL lint rules
# ============================================================

exec akb init cel-lint-kb
cd cel-lint-kb

# Write fresh pages
exec akb write notes/fresh.md <../fresh-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/fresh.md'

exec akb write decisions/fresh-adr.md <../fresh-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/fresh-adr.md'

# Write stale pages
exec akb write notes/stale.md <../stale-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/stale.md'

exec akb write decisions/stale-adr.md <../stale-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/stale-adr.md'

# Run lint — should find stale pages via cel_lint
! exec akb lint
stdout 'cel_lint'
stdout 'adr_stale'
stdout 'note_stale'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: JSON output includes rule_id
# ============================================================

! exec akb lint --json
stdout '"cel_lint"'
stdout '"rule_id"'
stdout '"adr_stale"'
stdout '"note_stale"'
stdout '"severity"'
stdout '"warning"'

# ============================================================
# Section 3: Exit code handling
# ============================================================

# Lint with warnings only should still exit 1 because there are errors
# from other checks (orphans, broken_links, etc.)
# But let's test a clean KB with only warnings

# Create a clean KB
exec akb init clean-cel-kb
cd clean-cel-kb

exec akb write notes/fresh.md <../fresh-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/fresh.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/fresh.md "Fresh note"

# In a clean KB with only fresh pages, lint should pass
exec akb lint
stdout 'No issues found.'

# Verify exit code is 0
exit 0
